median_household_income.label: Median household income
median_household_income.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
median_household_income.note: Half of households earn more and half earn less. Dollars are nominal: each 5-year period is in its own final year's dollars, so older values are not adjusted for inflation.

poverty_rate.label: Share of people in poverty
poverty_rate.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
poverty_rate.note: People whose family income is below the federal poverty line (table C17002). The poverty line is the same across the country and does not change with local living costs. Margins of error are at 90% confidence; for this share they use the Census Bureau's approximation for proportions.

near_poverty_share.label: Share of people just above the poverty line
near_poverty_share.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
near_poverty_share.note: People, not households, whose family income is between 100% and 199% of the federal poverty line (C17002). The poverty line is a federal measure that does not change with local living costs. Margins of error are at 90% confidence; for this share they use the Census Bureau's approximation for proportions.

below_200_share.label: Share of people below twice the poverty line
below_200_share.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
below_200_share.note: People whose family income is below 200% of the federal poverty line (C17002): those in poverty plus those just above it. Margins of error are at 90% confidence; for this share they use the Census Bureau's approximation for proportions.

snap_households_share.label: Households that got SNAP food aid
snap_households_share.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
snap_households_share.note: Households that received SNAP (food stamps) at any time in the past 12 months, as reported in the survey (B22003). Surveys tend to undercount program use. Margins of error are at 90% confidence; for this share they use the Census Bureau's approximation for proportions.

gini.label: Income inequality (Gini index)
gini.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
gini.note: Household income inequality on a scale from 0 (all equal) to 1 (one household has all income) (B19083).
